title: Chapter 390: Bloodthirsty Leader Jin Guozhu
content:
Chapter 390: Bloodthirsty Leader Jin Guozhu

The Alligator Commander was full of confidence in this battle.

If they could conquer it, the Demon King would reward the entire Dahuai Territory to the Alligator Tribe and merge this land into the Alligator Ridge. Thinking of this, a smile appeared on his lips.

The other invading force was the human race, with a more complex personnel.

They were a coalition formed by many forces.

Among them were local forces generated in the last trial space, and some forces in the earlier trial space. Some of these forces had already established city-states or kingdoms.

The largest force was the Bloodthirsty Guards sent by the Iron Blood Lord, with a total of 20,000 people. In addition, there were some more powerful forces, such as Sunset City, Qingyang City, Storm City, etc.

Some of them were hostile forces, but at this moment they belonged to the same camp.

For the Dahuai Territory, they were all invading forces.

The Iron Blood Lord sent the vanguard this time, the Bloodthirsty Guards Commander Jin Guozhu.

This man is brave, resourceful, and meticulous. He is an excellent commander. He played an important role in the war of expanding the territory of Tiexue Ridge. He is a capable general under the Iron Blood Lord Liu Hong.

In this invasion, the lords of the big forces will not come in person. Compared with the new territory, they are more vigilant about some old forces around them.

If you are not in the territory, the opponent suddenly attacks the old nest, it will not be fun.

At this time, Jin Guozhu was in the big tent, blowing his beard and glaring.

The reason is that other forces that should have been under his control did not obey his orders.

There are several big forces that don't care about him at all. He sent these leaders to discuss the offensive strategy, but they didn't come, and there was not even a representative.

If it weren't for the imminent war, he would have eliminated these guys who didn't obey his orders first.

The next morning, the first ray of morning sun shone on the barrier, emitting colorful light.

The barrier was as fragile as a soap bubble and burst all at once.

Golden light burst out of Lapachi's eyes, as if a piece of fat meat was right in front of him.

A cricket the size of a dog moved its mouthparts, its abdomen swelled up, and then it exhaled and exhaled, and a huge horn-like sound came out of its mouth.

This was the horn of attack.

Countless beasts rushed to the Great Wall first.

Obviously, this was the first wave of cannon fodder.

Although they were cannon fodder, they were also aggressive because there were too many of them.

Wang Shuo looked at the black and gray stream of insects in front of him, and he couldn't help but feel a little scared.

If someone had intensive phobia, he would probably faint on the spot.

Wang Shuo prepared sufficient defensive supplies this time.

In the past three months, the craftsmen in Wana County worked day and night to make a large number of thunders.

At the same time, they also studied the production method of thunders from the "Craftsman's Manual". Although the power is smaller than that of thunders, the output is much larger.

Moreover, they also developed a more powerful thunder.

One bullet can cause 10,000 health points of damage.

Even Wang Shuo was a little afraid of this kind of ammunition.

After upgrading to a general, Wang Shuo's health has exceeded 10,000.

But if he takes such a bullet head-on, he will be seriously injured.

To deal with this kind of insect with low health, it is best to use thunder bombs, so as not to waste the damage value of ammunition.

So, countless thunder bombs were seen on the wall, like hail, hitting the Great Wall within a hundred meters.

The explosions were crackling, like cannons.

The tide of insects was constantly cleared, like white flowers painted on a black canvas.
